name: loanword
description: Turn your Claude Code sessions into a personal phrasebook. Learn the words you actually needed today.

native_lang.title: Native language
native_lang.description: The language you write prompts in (ISO code: es, pt, de, uk…)

target_lang.title: Target language
target_lang.description: The language you are learning (en, de, ja…)

mode.title: Capture mode
mode.description: active — your prompts only (how to say what you meant); passive — assistant replies only (new words from context); both — either

daily_limit.title: New cards per day
daily_limit.description: Cap on new cards per day. The FSRS review queue is not limited by this number

auto_build.title: Auto-build on session end
auto_build.description: Offer to build cards at the end of a session once the queue holds 10 or more records

echo.title: Echo the native phrasing
echo.description: off — nothing; line — Claude opens every reply with the one line a native speaker would have used for your prompt; weave — the same, plus your ten weakest words worked into the answer. Costs a line of every response

level.title: Your level (optional)
level.description: A2/B1/B2/C1 — words below this level never become cards. Empty means no level filter

peek.title: Show a card while Claude works
peek.description: Print one flashcard into the session while you wait for an answer. Nothing is graded — it is a glance, not a test

peek_pick.title: Which words to show
peek_pick.description: Comma-separated, any mix of: starred, slipping, leech, new, and the levels A1 A2 B1 B2 C1 C2. States are combined, levels narrow the result. Example: starred,slipping,B1,B2. Empty means every card

peek_every.title: Minutes between cards
peek_every.description: At most one card per this many minutes, however many prompts you send
